rationale: Genome-wide PDL1 (Cd274) sort screen in the same BMDC system: one repeat, top and bottom 10% of PD-L1. One library per bin, so run_barcs.R uses the no-replicate path with an overdispersion pooled over the 986 BRDN non-targeting guides; the calls are screening-level. Term is low vs high, the sign of the authors' MAGeCK lfc. prepare.R removes the byte-order mark from the GEO file's first column name.
